title: Buffalo Before Breakfast
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie meet the Lakota people on the Great Plains and learn from the buffalo. 杰克和安妮在大平原上遇见拉科塔人，向野牛学习。🐃

q.en: Which Native American people did Jack and Annie meet?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮遇见的是哪一支原住民？

options.en: Cherokee, though that is another story
options.zh: 切罗基人，不过那是另一个故事了

explain.en: They met the Lakota, a people also known as the Sioux, on the Great Plains.
explain.zh: 他们在美洲大平原上遇见了拉科塔人，也就是苏族。

options.zh: 一位年轻的拉科塔战士

options.en: A Lakota grandmother, as someone else had told it
options.zh: 一位拉科塔的老奶奶，那是别人讲的版本

explain.en: Black Hawk was a young Lakota warrior who lived with his grandmother.
explain.zh: 布莱克·霍克是一位年轻的拉科塔战士，和祖母住在一起。

q.en: What did the two-finger sign mean?
q.zh: 那两个手指的手势是什么意思？

explain.en: Holding up two fingers was the Lakota sign for 'friend.'
explain.zh: 举起两根手指是拉科塔人表示‘朋友’的手势。

q.en: Which of these came from the buffalo?
q.zh: 下面哪一样是用野牛换来的？

options.en: Wooden houses, in a place far away
options.zh: 木头的房子，在很远很远的地方

explain.en: The buffalo gave the people food, tepees made of hide, tools, cups, ropes, and sleds.
explain.zh: 野牛为人们提供了食物、用皮做的帐篷、工具、杯子、绳索和雪橇。

q.en: What were the two ponies' names?
q.zh: 那两匹小马叫什么名字？

explain.en: The black pony was called Midnight and the yellow one was called Sunlight.
explain.zh: 黑色的小马叫午夜，黄色的小马叫阳光。

q.en: About how many bison lived in America at the start of the 1800s?
q.zh: 在19世纪初，美洲大约有多少头野牛？

explain.en: There were about 40 million bison at the start of the 1800s, but later fewer than 300 remained.
explain.zh: 19世纪初约有四千万头野牛，后来却只剩下不到三百头。

q.zh: 布莱克·霍克身上穿着什么？

explain.en: Black Hawk wore a wolf hide as part of his warrior dress.
explain.zh: 布莱克·霍克披着一张狼皮，那是战士的装束。

q.en: Who was the White Buffalo Woman?

options.en: A queen from a far city, in a place far away
A spirit who brought a sacred pipe

explain.en: The White Buffalo Woman was a spirit and messenger of the Great Spirit who brought the sacred pipe.
explain.zh: 白野牛女郎是一位神灵，也是大神的信使，她带来了神圣的烟斗。

q.en: What did Grandmother give as the gift from the prairie?
q.zh: 老奶奶送出的、来自草原的礼物是什么？

options.en: A red blanket, though that is another story
options.zh: 一条红毯子，不过那是另一个故事了

explain.en: Grandmother gave Jack and Annie an eagle's feather as the gift from the prairie blue.
explain.zh: 老奶奶把一根鹰羽送给杰克和安妮，作为来自蓝色草原的礼物。

q.en: What Lakota name was Annie given?
q.zh: 安妮被起了个什么拉科塔名字？

explain.en: Annie was named Buffalo Girl, while Jack was called Rides-Like-Wind.
explain.zh: 安妮被叫作‘野牛姑娘’，而杰克被叫作‘像风一样奔跑’。
